name: Barrier
effect: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply boosts its Defense stat.

name: Haze

effect: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This move has a 30% chance of confusing the target. If this move misses or fails, the user takes damage equal to 1/2 of its max HP instead.

name: Last Respects
effect: The user attacks to avenge its allies. This move’s power is increased by 50 for each time that a Pokémon in the user’s party has fainted.

name: Lumina Crash
effect: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: Order Up
effect: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts the user’s stats based on the Tatsugiri’s form: Attack for Curly Tatsugiri, Defense for Droopy, or Speed for Stretchy.

name: Jet Punch
effect: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

name: Spicy Extract
effect: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target’s Attack stat and harshly lowering the target’s Defense stat.

name: Spin Out
effect: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user’s Speed stat.

name: Population Bomb
effect: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target 1 to 10 times in a row. The attack ends if the user misses.

name: Ice Spinner
effect: The user covers itself in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move’s spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

name: Glaive Rush
effect: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

name: Revival Blessing
effect: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon’s max HP.

name: Salt Cure
effect: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage equal to 1/16 of the target’s max HP at the end of every turn. Steel and Water types take damage equal to 1/8 of their max HP instead.

name: Triple Dive
effect: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water 3 times in a row.

name: Mortal Spin
effect: The user performs a spin attack that can eliminate the effects of binding moves and Leech Seed, as well as any entry hazards on its side. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

name: Doodle
effect: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

name: Fillet Away
effect: The user loses 1/2 of its max HP to sharply boost its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats. This move fails if the user doesn’t have enough remaining HP.

name: Kowtow Cleave
effect: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

name: Flower Trick
effect: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

name: Torch Song
effect: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: Aqua Step
effect: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

name: Raging Bull
effect: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect. When used by Tauros, this move’s type changes depending on its form.

name: Make It Rain
effect: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat. If a target is successfully struck, you will earn money after the battle.

name: Psyblade
effect: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move’s power is boosted by 50% if the user is on Electric Terrain.

name: Hydro Steam
effect: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move’s power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50%.

name: Ruination
effect: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This deals damage to the target equal to 1/2 of their remaining HP.

name: Collision Course
effect: The user rushes forward and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move’s power is boosted by 33% if it’s a supereffective hit.

name: Electro Drift
effect: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move’s power is boosted by 33% if it’s a supereffective hit.

name: Shed Tail
effect: The user creates a substitute for itself using 1/2 of its max HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: Chilly Reception
effect: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting 5 turns.

name: Tidy Up
effect: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

name: Snowscape
effect: The user summons a snowstorm lasting 5 turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types by 50%.

name: Pounce
effect: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

name: Trailblaze
effect: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user’s nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

name: Chilling Water
effect: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that’s so cold it saps the target’s power. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

name: Hyper Drill
effect: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

name: Twin Beam
effect: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

name: Rage Fist
effect: The user attacks by converting its rage into energy. This move’s power is increased by 50 each time the user takes damage from a move, up to a maximum power of 350. If the user switches out of battle, the move’s power returns to its usual value.

name: Armor Cannon
effect: The user attacks by shooting off its own armor as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

name: Bitter Blade
effect: The user attacks by focusing all its bitter feelings toward this world into the tip of its blade. The user’s HP is restored by 1/2 of the damage dealt by this move.

name: Double Shock
effect: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack, and loses the Electric type. This move fails unless it is used by a Electric type.

name: Gigaton Hammer
effect: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

name: Comeuppance
effect: The user retaliates to deal 1.5x of the damage it took from an opponent’s move during the turn this move is used.

name: Aqua Cutter
effect: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

name: Blazing Torque
effect: The user rams into the target with blazing energy. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target.

name: Wicked Torque
effect: The user rams into the target with malicious intent. This move has a 10% chance of putting the target to sleep.

name: Noxious Torque
effect: The user rams into the target with a poisonous end. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

name: Combat Torque
effect: The user rams into the target with great force. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

name: Magical Torque
effect: The user rams into the target with a fae-like force. This move has a 30% chance of confusing the target.

name: Blood Moon
effect: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

name: Matcha Gotcha
effect: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user’s HP is restored by 1/2 of the damage dealt by this move, and has a 20% chance of burning targets. This will also thaw out a frozen user or target.

name: Syrup Bomb
effect: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target’s Speed stat to drop at the end of every turn for 3 turns.

name: Ivy Cudgel
effect: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage. When used by Ogerpon, this move’s type changes depending on the mask worn.

name: Electro Shot
effect: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

name: Tera Starstorm
effect: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user when Terastallized.

name: Fickle Beam
effect: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. There is a 30% chance that all of the user’s heads will shoot beams in unison, doubling the move’s power.

name: Burning Bulwark
effect: The user intensely heats up a part of its body, protecting it from attacks and also causing burns to any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

name: Thunderclap
effect: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

name: Mighty Cleave
effect: The user wields the light that has accumulated through its blades to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

name: Tachyon Cutter
effect: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

name: Hard Press
effect: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 100).

name: Dragon Cheer
effect: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. Dragon types receive a 2-stage boost. All other types receive a 1-stage boost.

name: Alluring Voice
effect: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

name: Temper Flare
effect: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move’s power is doubled if the user’s previous move failed.

name: Supercell Slam
effect: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. The user takes damage equal to 1/2 of its max HP if this move misses or fails. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

name: Psychic Noise
effect: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For 2 turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

name: Upper Hand
effect: The user reacts to the target’s movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

name: Malignant Chain
effect: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This move has a 50% chance of badly poisoning the target.

name: Nihil Light
effect: The user attacks by unleashing a powerful light that defies all laws of nature, striking even Fairy types and ignoring any stat changes affecting its targets.
